tools.name: apps_list
tools.description: List Apps and retained drafts on the invited host.

tools.name: apps_state
tools.description: Read the active App draft, desired/saved revisions and actual target application states. Read this after interruption; do not infer application from file transfer success.

tools.name: apps_create
tools.description: Create a new App workspace. Returns its actual cwd; does not change the shared shell directory.

tools.name: apps_open
tools.description: Open an existing App or retained draft. Returns cwd; never overwrites a draft or sends cd to the shared PTY.

tools.name: apps_publish
tools.description: After all files and build steps in a complete editing round finish, publish its exact draftRevision. A failed target load preserves the old applied revision.

tools.name: apps_save
tools.description: Publish the completed draft and atomically save its .vrchapp package. Separate saved package success from preview/device application results.

tools.name: apps_preview_input
tools.description: Send a normalized control or pointer event to the connected preview only. Requires current AI editing control; cannot launch or control the device App.

tools.name: apps_operation_status
tools.description: Query the durable result of an interrupted App action. Do not automatically replay a mutation.

tools.name: apps_export_begin
tools.description: Fix a read-only snapshot of an already saved App for file_download. Does not Save or require editing control.

tools.name: apps_import_inspect
tools.description: Validate a completed .vrchapp app-package upload. Returns its inspected reference and update conflict/confirmation state; file_done alone never imports an App.

tools.name: apps_import_commit
tools.description: Commit an inspected App package using its previous package digest and the approved update decision.

tools.name: apps_launch
tools.description: Launch or focus a saved App on the device within this invitation’s enabled Launch/Exit scope. Read apps_state first. Supply replaceInstanceId only after deciding to replace that known target; on capability_required, inspect the returned manifestDigest and requestedCapabilities. Within an authorized App launch task, retry with those exact values and allow:true to grant its declared App communication capabilities. Browser/OS permissions and Allow AI still require the person. Does not save a draft.

allow.description: Explicitly grant only the exact capability_required decision returned for this saved App.

tools.name: apps_exit
tools.description: Exit the specified current device App within this invitation’s enabled Launch/Exit scope. Preserves the shell, access, App files and saved data. Read apps_state after interruption; never replay blindly.

tools.name: apps_input_targets
tools.description: Read the actual active preview and device App bindings before input. Coordinates are normalized within the App viewport, independent of the device’s 150% browser zoom. Does not launch, link or switch the person’s preview.

tools.name: apps_control
tools.description: Simulate known E1-E4 rotation/press and K1-K4 keys on an explicit active preview or device App. down/up/cancel send exact phases; click/long form a paired press using holdMs (default 50/800 ms). K1 always invokes the host Menu. Requires AI control; loss of control cancels only AI-held inputs.

tools.name: apps_host_input
tools.description: Open and operate Menu or Device for the active device App, only when ai_capabilities.hostMenus enables that surface and AI owns control. Read apps_input_targets first. event open opens the named menu; click/drag/scroll coordinates are normalized to the ENTIRE host window (including Monitor bars), not the App viewport. Supports touch-style pointer interaction and navigation keys. Does not operate permission/AI approval, access-management or lifecycle controls. Never sends caller-supplied script or selectors. Verify screenshots/state after delivery.

event.description: type: open/click/drag/scroll/key. open needs no coordinates. Pointer x,y and drag toX,toY: 0..1 of the whole host window. Scroll deltaX,deltaY: -2000..2000 CSS pixels. Keys: Tab/Enter/Escape/space/arrows/Home/End; optional shiftKey. No text or browser modifier shortcuts.

tools.name: apps_interface_input
tools.description: Click, drag, scroll, type English/ASCII text or send a key/chord in the active device App interface. Use event type guide_start to press the current App Guide Start on an explicit preview/device target; it does not approve access or I/O. Use apps_host_input for Menu/Device. Permission dialogs remain human-operated. Read apps_input_targets first; pointer coordinates are normalized App coordinates, scroll deltas are CSS pixels. Delivery confirms sent/dispatched events; use screenshots/App state to verify the intended result.

target.description: Default device; preview supports guide_start only.

event.description: type: guide_start/click/drag/scroll/text/key. guide_start has no coordinates and only presses the current first-open Guide Start. Pointer x,y and drag toX,toY: 0..1. Scroll deltaX,deltaY: -2000..2000. Text: ASCII, max2048. Key: Enter/Tab/Backspace/Delete/arrows/Home/End/Escape or one ASCII character; ctrlKey/altKey/shiftKey/metaKey booleans.

tools.name: apps_file_export
tools.description: Create a fixed download snapshot of a relative file in the current App workspace. Returns its reference and sha256; use file_download with app-workspace. Does not change preview or save the App.

tools.name: apps_file_commit
tools.description: Atomically deliver a completed app-workspace upload to a relative workspace path. Omit expectedSha256 only for a new file; supply the existing file sha256 to replace it. Does not publish, save or execute the file.

tools.name: file_upload
tools.description: Upload a local regular file through the shared resumable file transport. App packages must use .vrchapp and remain private until inspect/commit.

tools.name: file_download
tools.description: Download an authorized fixed App package reference to a new local path, verifying all bytes before an atomic no-overwrite commit.

tools.name: file_pause
tools.description: Pause the current shared file transfer.

tools.name: file_resume
tools.description: Resume the current shared file transfer.

tools.name: file_cancel
tools.description: Cancel the current shared file transfer.

tools.name: ai_report
tools.description: Report the current action, result or next step to the person in one or two brief sentences in their language. Works while waiting for Allow AI and after approval; never include raw commands, secrets or internal reasoning.

tools.name: terminal_run_private
tools.description: Run a command that needs a password or other secret using the device Private Input form. Supply only nonsecret argv; never put a password/token in argv, terminal_input, chat or a file. All command output is suppressed. Wait for device-confirmed waiting_for_private_input before asking the person to enter it in Private Input. Requires the privateCommand capability; fail closed on older devices. The ordinary shell is retained; a finished event includes only exitCode/reason. No credential argument exists.

tools.name: terminal_cancel_private_input
tools.description: Only when the person explicitly asks, cancel the current private input without reading or submitting it. Interrupts the waiting command and discards unsubmitted input; submitted input cannot be retracted. Set resumeAI true only when the person also authorizes continuing AI work. Requires an approved connection and the device cancelPrivateInput capability. Inspect state after interruption; never replay blindly.

tools.name: ai_capabilities
tools.description: Read actual enabled capabilities, targets, control owner and pause state for this approved connection. Unavailable capabilities do not prevent connection.

tools.name: terminal_connect
tools.description: Join an invited device Terminal. Wait for the human to approve once. Approval grants terminal observation and on-demand screenshots; Apps invitations grant AI editing on approval; ordinary Terminal invitations require the human to grant input control.

tools.name: terminal_events
tools.description: Read terminal events and actual images shared by the human automatically. Call terminal_events({}) while waiting for ai_pending/approval and between actions. Omit waitSeconds for the normal 20-second wait; returns early on events. Does not take a screenshot. One complete queued capture batch is returned per call, with separate images for every captured screen.

waitSeconds.description: Optional; omit for 20 seconds. Valid range 0..25; returns early when events arrive.

tools.name: terminal_input
tools.description: Send nonsecret shell input only while the human has granted AI input control. For commands needing credentials, use terminal_run_private and wait for device-confirmed Private Input. Never send passwords/tokens through this tool. Shared screenshots are included automatically in the response.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the device screens once and return the complete batch as separate images. Default follows the human Multi-screen setting: on captures all screens, off captures primary only. While on, screen may select primary or a display connector from prior image metadata. Does not change input control.

screen.description: Optional: all, primary, or a display connector. Omit to follow the human setting.

tools.name: terminal_disconnect
tools.description: Disconnect this client. Retain the admitted session credential for resuming within its authorization.
